column1: # How each app of the Q25 appears in Bold7 (AppTable.kt): grid, folders, search. Tab-separated:
# package, activity (* for all of them), BBOS 7 name (- keeps Android's), shown or hidden, source.
# An app absent here shows under its own name. A name comes from the 9900's 7.1 user guide (B,
# pages 16 to 18 of the Quick Help icon list, assets-private/reference-bbos7/manuels/), the
# simulator (C, docs/BBOS7-VISUEL.md) or the firmware's resource names (A); D is deduced, said in
# the line. Hiding is display only: the app stays installed and enabled, the search finds it, and
# the launcher's files/hidden-apps.tsv overrides this column app by app (OS 7's Hide and Show All).
# Renamed after the BBOS 7 app that does the same job.

# leaves the grid under its own Play Store name, never a second Text

column5: C sim-05 (the switcher names apps the BB way); D: the task of Google's engine, hidden behind Bold7's Messages

column1: # Options is Bold7's own (the launcher's OptionsActivity); Android's Settings leaves the
# grid under its own name, reached from the entries Options does not draw yet; Show All shows it.
# Phone is Bold7's own (apps/phone), the call screen once tools/dialer.sh gives it
# DIALER. Google's Phone, Telecom's system dialer and the way back, leaves the grid under its own
# name; Show All shows it, the search finds it.

column5: C BBOS7-VISUEL.md section 2 (sim-15), absent from the guide's icon list

column1: # Clock is Bold7's own (apps/clock). Google's Clock leaves the grid under its own
# name, its alarms untouched: both clocks ring; Show All shows it, the search finds it.
# Calendar is Bold7's own (apps/calendar), on the same calendar provider. Google
# Calendar stays the engine of the reminders (its notifications, untouched) and leaves the grid
# under its own name; Show All shows it, the search finds it.
# Contacts is Bold7's own (apps/contacts), over Android's contacts provider. Google's
# Contacts leaves the grid under its own name, the contacts untouched (the same provider); Show All
# shows it, the search finds it.
# Hidden: duplicates of an app above or of Bold7's own (Google's search, its Assistant and Photos,
# Games, a second browser, the XMPP client the 9900 would call BBM).

column5: D Google, duplicate of the home's search
D Assistant, duplicate of the home's search
B p16; D second messenger, hidden

column1: # Technical tools of BenOS and of the phone: BlackBerry had none on its grid.
# Calculator is Bold7's own (apps/calculator). Google's leaves the grid under its
# own name; Show All shows it, the search finds it.
# Flashlight is Bold7's own (apps/flashlight), new on the grid: the 9900 had no flashlight,
# so its name and its icon (a pictogram on OS 7's tile, drawn by the app, no row in bbos7_icons.tsv:
# there is no theme PNG for it) are D. Q25's BenOS LED app stays hidden above; no Google lamp is installed.
# MemoPad is Bold7's own (apps/memopad), its memos in its own database. Google Keep
# leaves the grid under its own name, its notes untouched and not imported; Show All shows it, the
# Pictures is Bold7's own (apps/pictures), over MediaStore. Aves, its engine before,
# leaves the grid under its own name, its pictures untouched (the same MediaStore); Show All shows
# Tasks is Bold7's own (apps/tasks), its tasks in its own database. The Q25 has no Tasks
# app to hide: the OS 7 name is new on the grid, after the guide's list.
